name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to Anthropic’s latest Claude 3.7 Sonnet. It’s the only model that consistently outperforms others on complex reasoning tasks, which directly raises EXCAVA’s capability ceiling. The trade-off is higher cost per token, but the 0.5%+ gain in precision justifies it.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just cost—it’s benchmark drift. EXCAVA’s live task accuracy already lags Sonnet 3.7’s promised 0.7% gain by 0.3% in our last run; switching models mid-stream could widen that gap if the new model’s strengths don’t align with our specific prompt chains. Test Sonnet 3.7 on a 500-sample slice of our production data first—if the delta holds, switch; if not, fall back to the current model and audit why the gap exists.
